prompts.A: Use case: illustration-story. Original Japanese middle-school mathematics lesson illustration, landscape 16:9. Exactly TWO middle-school students facing a simple shared tabletop: a boy on the LEFT and a girl on the RIGHT. LEFT student has exactly FOUR identical small opaque sealed paper bags; RIGHT student has exactly THREE identical bags. Exactly SEVEN bags total, absolutely no extra bags or objects resembling bags. All seven bags have the same shape, size and plain blank surface. Contents completely hidden: no candy visible, no transparent windows, no printed text or numbers, no mathematical labels or answers. Left group: four clearly separated bags in a single neat row in front of boy; right group: three clearly separated bags in a single neat row in front of girl. Both students use their hands to slide their own group toward the same empty central area of the tabletop, conveying combining identical units; hands must not hide any bag, bags must not overlap. Keep both groups visibly distinct and fully countable. No duplication in hands/background, no trays, no logos or watermark, no lettering anywhere. Generous white background, sparse classroom surroundings, friendly and age-appropriate. Strong outlines and separation readable in monochrome and at tablet size. Style: Warm editorial ink illustration with soft muted colors, eye-level three-quarter view emphasizing bags.
